title: Enforce wave bound and verified health in fleet rollout (VC-201-068)
goal: VC-201-068 refuted: mark_applied accepts any node regardless of the open wave — pending() is advisory, so bounded waves are not enforced; rollback() marks a node healthy with no health evidence and resume() accepts it, so resume does not require verified health; an empty canary leaves pending() empty while the rollout reports Running; and fleet_rollout has no production caller (no config driver applies pending nodes). Evidence: crates/susi-config/src/tests/vc_201_068_mastery.rs.
